name: 音声の入力と出力を整える設定シート
prompt:
Create a crisp flat Japanese audio settings screen at exactly 390×514. Use the native 390×514 preview as the exact source of truth for content, text, geometry, and state. Use the original screenshot crop only for visual context. Reuse the white/no-tint card treatment from the prior audio input and output control candidates. Preserve the established Meiryo typography.

User-directed no-tint rule: the page is pure white #FFFFFF, and both the input and output cards are white #FFFFFF with a thin neutral #E8ECE9 outline and 12px corners. Remove their mint/pastel fills. No green wash, tinted surface, gradient, glow, or decorative color. Keep forest green #047857 only for the meaningful active controls: the ON sensitivity switch, the 150px live voice-detection segment, and the 168px volume value segment. Their green state is explicitly explained by the native helper copy and represents the saved/live values. Use white switch thumb and slider knob. Speaker icons use consistent slate #526173. Main text #1D1D1D and supporting labels/body #6E6E6E. There is no hyperlink in the native preview, so add no blue text and no source-only help link.

Preserve the exact 390×514 layout and all Japanese wording:
- Title 音声の設定 at x24 y10, 342×28, Meiryo Bold 20px, centered.
- Section label 入力 at x16 y70, 358×16, Meiryo Regular 12px, gray.
- Input card at x16 y104, 358×256, 12px corners. - Section label 出力 at x16 y386, 358×16, Meiryo Regular 12px gray.
- Output card x16 y420, 358×92, 12px corners. Inside: 音量 x30 y430, 330×24, Meiryo Bold 14px; slate left speaker icon x32 y471, 24.75×20; neutral rail x72 y478, 236×4, radius2; green volume segment x72 y478, 168×4; white knob x230 y468, 24×24 with neutral outline and very soft shadow; slate right speaker icon x336 y471, 24.75×20.

Keep these positions, sizes, spacing, lines, states, and wording exact. Do not add the English source's troubleshooting guide, wallpaper, artwork, extra icons or controls, numbers, or device frame.
